purpose: Manual source-text review of every returned mention; evaluation evidence, never production mapping rules
scope: All nine applied grounding examples plus all seven built-in benchmark notes, all 297 top proposals and their displayed alternatives. Raw candidate pool membership was checked separately; no claim of manual adjudication of every raw candidate.

verdicts.supported: The top proposal's base meaning and context are supported by the note; does not imply automatic acceptance, structured export completeness, or setting-specific coding approval.
verdicts.partial: A useful base concept is present, but specificity, temporal scope, provenance, or context needs correction before the fact is considered complete.
verdicts.reject: The proposed concept adds unsupported meaning, changes the clinical fact, or reverses the source scope; reject the top candidate even if it remains under review/abstain.
verdicts.unresolved: No adequate coded result is supplied for a clinically meaningful source fact; retain uncoded evidence and search further.
verdicts.context: Code-free context or a relation is appropriate; preserve its source qualifiers without inventing a diagnosis.
